notes.title: LIGHTKRAVTE UPDATE 1.02
notes.content:
LIGHTKRAVTE has been updated to ver1.02 since 8/25.

The contents are as follows
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
- Added a chapter select that will appear after finishing the game
- Various bug fixes
- Massive improvements to stability and general performance
- Linux version should now be fully  functional even without Proton
＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝＝
We look forward to continuing to work with you in the future. 
Thank you for your continued support of "fault -StP- LIGHTKRAVTE".
